raw_segments.text: The Consul did not finish his sentence, for as he spoke a knock was heard at the door
and two strangers entered, one of whom was the servant whom Fix had met on the key.
The other, who was his master, held out his passport with the request that the Consul
would do him the favor to visa it.
The Consul took the document and carefully read it, whilst Fix observed, or rather devoured,
the stranger with his eyes from a corner of the room.
